title: The game I've spent 3.5 years and my savings on has been rejected and retired by Steam today
author: SpudMonkApe

comments.author: SpudMonkApe
comments.body: This isn't my game. Just forgot to change the title. Lots of interesting information in the comments. It seems like there are already games on Steam with A.I. generated art and also AI NPCs. But this guy implemented a lazy/sketchy (?) way for users to input their OpenAI key, which may have triggered red flags to the Steam team.
